911.title: William Lane Craig vs Alex Rosenberg on Intentional States of Consciousness In the World

95742.context: We need to face the fact that nihilism is true. By contrast, the theist grounds objective moral values in God and our moral duties in his commands. The theist thus has the explanatory resources which the atheist lacks to ground objective moral values and duties. Hence we may argue one, objective moral values and duties exist.
95742.title: "Is Faith In God Reasonable" - An Exchange on Objective Moral Values and Duties Part 1
